program.name: Calf Ladders
program.subject: Calves & lower legs
program.blurb: A lower-leg ladder every day, raises and hops a rep at a time, then the shins.
program.about: Every day climbs a lower-leg ladder: one calf raise and one hop, then two, then three, for as long as the time allows. A short block for the shins and calves follows. One day leads with the raises, the other with the hops. Ladders give the calves a lot of quality reps without the burn taking over. Abs finish every session; Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
